title: FliHub Phase 1H walkthrough — official results and corrections
note: Review preview — narration scripted (recordings/narration-phase1h.md). Record with `npm run record:walkthrough-1h`. The demo starts after the scorecards are submitted so the video focuses on official results, Viewer labels, and the correction lifecycle.
